name: HyperFrames Headless Video Renderer
purpose: Deterministic HTML5/SVG/Canvas frame-by-frame video rendering engine powered by headless Chromium and ANGLE Metal GPU acceleration.
capabilities: Deterministic frame-by-frame browser stepping via window.__timelines
Static syntax and tween overlap preflight linting (hyperframes lint)
High-speed H.264 video rendering with screenshot capture

installation.instructions: Installed globally via npm install -g hyperframes.

compatibility.notes: Must pass --low-memory-mode to pin worker pool to 1 on Apple Silicon 8GB.

licensing.notes: Verified CLI binary installed on host.

security.notes: Headless Chromium sandbox; renders local HTML files.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 5, Stage 6, and Stage 9.
